title: ConnectionsHostModeResult
description: Result of the connections.hostMode JSON-RPC method: the method the named connection's host uses, and whether this machine has any key for that host at all. The single declaration of this shape: the renderer's TypeScript type is generated from it and the Go transport is validated against it.

profileId.description: The connection that was asked about, echoed so the renderer keys the answer on the connection the backend resolved rather than its own copy of the request.

mode.description: The host's integration method. auto means no answer is recorded for this host's key yet — the connect-time ask will decide (ADR-0033) — and it is also the answer for a destination known_hosts has no key for, which hostKnown distinguishes.

hostKnown.description: Whether this machine's known_hosts holds at least one key for the connection's destination, resolved as a dial resolves it. False means the host has never been connected to, so a method cannot be recorded for it: the record is keyed by a host-key fingerprint, and the connection editor shows the control disabled with its effective value (auto) rather than hiding it.
